description: Ground truth Q&A pairs for sample PID pair

questions.question: What flow indicators were changed between the two revisions?
questions.answer: FI-201-01 was removed and FI-201-02 was added on line L-1001.

questions.question: What is the new setpoint for PIC-101-01?
questions.answer: The setpoint for PIC-101-01 was changed from 100 PSI to 150 PSI.

questions.question: Were any emergency shutdown valves added?
questions.answer: Yes, XV-301-01 was added as a new emergency shutdown valve on line L-1002.

questions.question: How many total changes were made between revisions?
questions.answer: There were 5 total changes: 2 added, 1 removed, and 2 modified elements.
